# Matcha-TTS subset

This directory contains only the Matcha-TTS modules imported by the bundled
CosyVoice codec path: selected decoder/flow components, HiFi-GAN helpers and
their package initializers. Training applications, notebooks, CI templates and
unrelated utilities were intentionally omitted from this portfolio snapshot.

The retained files remain under the upstream MIT license in `LICENSE`.
Upstream project: https://github.com/shivammehta25/Matcha-TTS
